scope: Batch Data Stream anchoring result error reporting

behavior.failed_post: Per-post failures return a bounded summary containing only the exception class; raw database/provider text is omitted.
behavior.partial_success: Successful posts retain their pending result, and batch totals continue to distinguish pending, failed, and skipped posts.

coverage: a secret-bearing failure for one post is excluded from batch output
a neighboring successful post remains pending and aggregate counts remain correct

limitations: No database or attestation provider was contacted.
This checks result redaction and partial-success accounting, not live EAS anchoring or signer delivery.
